### M-tron Industries, Inc. to Host 1x1 Investor Meetings at the Raymond James Investor-Led Sonoma Small Cap Symposium on November 16, 2026 in Sonoma, CA


November 03, 2026


ORLANDO, Fla.


, Nov. 3, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- M-tron Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: MPTI) ("Mtron" or the "Company") today announced that Cameron Pforr, Chief Executive Officer, and Chris Nossokoff, Vice President – Financial Reporting, will host one-on-one meetings with investors at the Raymond James Investor-Led Sonoma Small Cap Symposium on Monday, November 16, 2026 at The Lodge at Sonoma Resort, Autograph Collection, in Sonoma, California. Institutional investors are welcome to contact Raymond James to arrange one-on-one meetings with management.


**About M-tron Industries, Inc.**


M-tron Industries, Inc. (NYSE American: MPTI) designs, manufactures, and markets highly engineered, high reliability frequency and spectrum control products and solutions to customers in the aerospace and defense, avionics, space industries. As an engineering-centric company, Mtron provides close support to its customers throughout our products' entire life cycle, including product design, prototyping, production, and subsequent product upgrades. Mtron has design and manufacturing facilities in Orlando, Florida, and Yankton, South Dakota, a sales office in Hong Kong, and a manufacturing facility in Noida, India. For more information, visit[www.mtron.com](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4812551-1&h=369305136&u=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.mtron.com%2F&a=www.mtron.com) .
